sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Liquid AI released two open-weight bidirectional encoders, LFM2.5-Encoder-230M and LFM2.5-Encoder-350M. Both carry an 8,192-token context and are built on the LFM2 hybrid backbone. The 350M ranks fourth of 14 models on a 17-task GLUE, SuperGLUE, and multilingual suite, behind only larger models. The 230M clears one 8K-token forward pass on CPU in about 28 seconds. The post Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-Encoder-230M and LFM2.5-Encoder-350M: Bidirectional Encoders That Stay Fast at 8K Context on CPU appeared first on MarkTechPost .
